about_short_description.short_description: Edfapay is a fintech enterprise that provides smart & efficient payment solutions.

product.name: EdfaPay Payment Gateway
product.description: An online payment gateway for accepting card, digital wallet, and local payment-scheme transactions, with recurring payments, fraud controls, reporting, and e-commerce integrations.

product.name: EdfaPay SoftPOS (Tap to Phone)
product.description: A software point-of-sale service that enables NFC-enabled Android smartphones and tablets to accept contactless card and digital wallet payments without additional POS hardware.

product.name: EdfaPay E-Invoicing
product.description: An electronic invoicing service for creating, sending, and tracking branded invoices with embedded payment links, QR codes, multiple payment methods, and real-time status updates.

product.name: EdfaPay Payout System
product.description: A payout and disbursement service for splitting and sending payments to multiple recipients, with automated processing, configurable fee profiles, bulk payments, and real-time tracking.

product.name: EdfaPay White-Label Payment Solutions
product.description: Customizable payment infrastructure that banks, financial institutions, and payment partners can offer under their own brands, including gateway, SoftPOS, and related payment services.

product.name: EdfaPay Payment APIs and SDKs
product.description: RESTful APIs, software development kits, libraries, webhooks, and testing tools for integrating payment acceptance, SoftPOS, analytics, and other EdfaPay capabilities into applications and platforms.
